name: gemini mcp add
description: Add an MCP server, either as a stdio launcher command or, with --transport http, as an HTTP server.

examples.explanation: Add a stdio server.

examples.command: gemini mcp add api-server http://localhost:3000 --transport http
examples.explanation: Add an HTTP server.

examples.command: gemini mcp add slack node server.js --env SLACK_TOKEN=xoxb-xxx --scope user
examples.explanation: Add a stdio server with a token, saved to user scope.

when_not_to_use: Read a server's command, URL, environment, and exposed tools before adding it; MCP tools act outside the repository.

name: gemini mcp list
description: List every configured MCP server.

examples.explanation: Show the configured servers.

name: gemini mcp remove
description: Remove a configured MCP server by name.

examples.explanation: Drop a server from the configuration.

name: gemini mcp enable
description: Enable a configured MCP server. With --session the change applies to the current session only and is not written to the settings file.

examples.explanation: Turn a configured server back on.
Turn it on for this session without persisting the change.

name: gemini mcp disable
description: Disable a configured MCP server without removing it. With --session the change applies to the current session only.

examples.explanation: Keep the configuration but stop starting the server.

when_to_use: Silence a noisy or slow server without losing how it was configured.

name: --transport
description: On gemini mcp add, register the server over HTTP rather than the default stdio transport.

examples.command: gemini mcp add api-server http://localhost:3000 --transport http
examples.explanation: Add an HTTP server.

name: --env
description: On gemini mcp add, set environment variables passed to the server process.

examples.command: gemini mcp add slack node server.js --env SLACK_TOKEN=xoxb-xxx
examples.explanation: Pass a token to a stdio server.

name: --include-tools
description: On gemini mcp add, expose only the named tools from the server instead of everything it offers.

examples.command: gemini mcp add github npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github --include-tools list_repos,get_pr
examples.explanation: Expose two tools from a large server.

when_to_use: Cut a broad server down to the tools you actually want the model reaching for.

name: --session
display_name: Apply an MCP change to this session only
description: On gemini mcp enable and disable, apply the change to the current session only, without persisting it to the settings file.

examples.explanation: Turn a server off for one session.

name: gemini extensions install
description: Install an extension from a Git repository URL or a local path.

examples.explanation: Install from a Git URL.
Install from a specific branch, tag, or commit.
Install and keep it updated automatically.

when_not_to_use: An extension runs with your CLI session's reach; install only from sources you trust.

name: gemini extensions uninstall
description: Uninstall one or more installed extensions by name.

examples.explanation: Remove one extension.

name: gemini extensions list
description: List the installed extensions.

examples.explanation: See what is installed.

name: gemini extensions update
description: Update a named extension, or every installed extension with --all, to the latest version.

examples.explanation: Update one extension.
Update everything installed.

name: gemini extensions enable
description: Enable an installed extension. --scope selects the settings scope the change is written to.

examples.explanation: Turn an extension back on.

name: gemini extensions disable
description: Disable an installed extension without uninstalling it. --scope selects the settings scope the change is written to.

examples.explanation: Keep an extension installed but inactive.

name: gemini extensions link
description: Link an extension from a local path, so edits to that path are always reflected without reinstalling.

examples.explanation: Develop an extension against a live checkout.

when_to_use: Iterate on an extension you are writing, rather than reinstalling after every change.

name: gemini extensions new
description: Create a new extension at the given path from a boilerplate example template.

examples.explanation: Scaffold an extension from the default template.

name: gemini extensions validate
description: Validate the structure of an extension at a local path before installing or publishing it.

examples.explanation: Check an extension's structure.

name: gemini extensions config
description: Read or change an extension's settings. --scope selects which settings scope is written.

examples.explanation: Inspect one extension's settings.

name: --ref
display_name: Install an extension from a Git ref
description: On gemini extensions install, install from a specific branch, tag, or commit rather than the default ref.

examples.explanation: Track a development branch.

name: --auto-update
description: On gemini extensions install, enable automatic updates for the extension being installed.

examples.explanation: Install and follow upstream automatically.

when_not_to_use: Automatic updates pull new code from the source without review; pin a ref instead when that matters.

name: --pre-release
description: On gemini extensions install, allow installation of pre-release versions rather than only the latest stable release tag.

examples.explanation: Install the newest version even when it is a pre-release.

name: --all
display_name: Apply an extension or skill command to everything
description: Apply the command to every item rather than a named one. Documented on gemini extensions update, gemini skills list, and gemini skills enable and disable.

examples.explanation: Update every installed extension.
Include built-in skills in the listing.

name: --scope
description: Choose which settings scope a change is written to: user (global, the default) or workspace (local to the project). Documented on the extension enable, disable, and config commands and on the skill install, disable, and uninstall commands.

examples.explanation: Install a skill for this project only.
Disable an extension everywhere.

name: gemini skills list
description: List the discovered agent skills. Add --all to include built-in skills.

examples.explanation: See the skills discovered for this project.
Include built-in skills in the listing.

name: gemini skills install
description: Install an agent skill from a Git repository URL, a local path, or a file. --path names a sub-directory inside a Git repository, and --scope selects user or workspace.

examples.explanation: Install a skill from a repository.

examples.command: gemini skills install https://github.com/u/repo --path skills/reviewer --scope workspace
examples.explanation: Install one skill from a monorepo, for this project only.

when_not_to_use: A skill is instructions the agent will follow; read one before installing it from a source you do not control.

name: gemini skills link
description: Link agent skills from a local path by symlink, so changes to the source are reflected immediately.

examples.explanation: Develop skills against a live checkout.

name: gemini skills uninstall
description: Uninstall an agent skill by name. --scope selects which scope it is removed from.

examples.explanation: Remove a skill.
Remove it from the project scope.

name: gemini skills enable
description: Enable an agent skill, or every skill with --all.

examples.explanation: Turn one skill on.
Turn every discovered skill on.

name: gemini skills disable
description: Disable an agent skill, or every skill with --all. --scope selects which scope the change is written to.

examples.explanation: Turn one skill off.
Turn every skill off.

name: --path
display_name: Install a skill from a sub-directory
description: On gemini skills install, name the sub-directory within a Git repository that contains the skill.

examples.explanation: Install one skill out of a repository that holds several.

name: gemini gemma
description: Manage local Gemma model routing, which serves a Gemma model from a local LiteRT-LM server instead of calling the hosted API.

examples.explanation: Check whether local routing is configured and running.

name: gemini gemma setup
description: Download and configure Gemma local model routing.

examples.explanation: Download the model and configure routing.

name: gemini gemma start
description: Start the local LiteRT-LM server that serves the Gemma model.

examples.explanation: Bring the local server up.

name: gemini gemma stop
description: Stop the local LiteRT-LM server.

examples.explanation: Shut the local server down and free its memory.

name: gemini gemma status
description: Report whether local Gemma model routing is configured and whether the server is running.

examples.explanation: Check the state of local routing.

name: gemini gemma logs
description: View the local LiteRT-LM server logs.

examples.explanation: Read the server logs when local routing misbehaves.

name: --acp
description: Start the agent in ACP mode, for editors and clients that drive Gemini CLI over the Agent Client Protocol. Replaces --experimental-acp.

examples.explanation: Run the agent as an ACP server for an editor client.

name: --policy
description: Load additional user policy files or directories for the Policy Engine. Accepts a comma-separated list, or repeat the flag.

examples.explanation: Load one extra policy file for this run.

name: --admin-policy
description: Load additional admin policy files or directories. Admin policies are supplemental and are applied on top of user policy.

examples.explanation: Apply an organization's policy directory.
